* '''Original''' ([[Ahsoka's Shoto Lightsaber]], 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value (if hit target is an Inquisitor, opponent also loses 1 Force).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-ahsokasshotolightsaber-20220531.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ahsokasshotolightsaber.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], no mark). Text: “Deploy on Ahsoka or a non-[Episode I] Padawan. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value (if hit target is an Inquisitor, opponent also loses 1 Force).” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
*: [[File:V14-L-ahsokasshotolightsaber-20220531-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ahsoka's Shoto Lightsaber (Errata 2)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-ahsokasshotolightsaber.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ahsokasshotolightsaber.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Deploy on a Jedi or Padawan. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value. If hit by Ahsoka or a Padawan, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' “Deploy on Ahsoka or a non-[Episode I] Padawan.” became “Deploy on a Jedi or Padawan.”; “(if hit target is an Inquisitor, opponent also loses 1 Force)” became “If hit by Ahsoka or a Padawan, opponent loses 1 Force.”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
